notices.title: Spanish Fork City Council Public Hearing Notice Zone Changes, Title 15 Amendments, General Plan Map Amendment
notices.agenda_text:
Information to post for the State Public Notice Website:
Notice of Public Hearings

The City Council and Planning Commission will hold public hearings on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, and
Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 6:00 pm.

Zone Change & General Plan Amendment (Public Hearing):
Shady Oaks Event Center
Public hearings will be held with the Planning Commission and City Council on a proposed Zone Map
Amendment and a General Plan Amendment on the subject property located at 3575 East River Bottoms
Road. The Zone Map Amendment would change the zoning from R-1-30 to C-O and the General Plan
Amendment would change the land use designation from Medium Density Residential to Mixed Use.

Zone Change (Public Hearing):
Builders FirstSource
Public hearings will be held with the Planning Commission and City Council on a proposed Zone Map
Amendment to change the zoning of the subject property located at 1617 North 300 West, from R-R to I-1.

Zone Change (Public Hearing):
Nelson Commercial
Public hearings will be held with the Planning Commission and City Council on a proposed Zone Change from
R-R Rural Residential to C-2 General Commercial for property located at 2162 South Main Street.

General Plan Map Amendment, Zone Change & Preliminary Plat (Public Hearing):
Ridgeline Townhomes
Public hearings will be held with the Planning Commission and City Council to review the proposed Ridgeline
Townhomes development, located at approximately 1217 North SR-51. The proposal involves a General Plan
Map Amendment from Business Park to High Density Residential and a Zone Change request from C-2
General Commercial to R-3 Residential. This includes the Master Planned Development Overlay to allow for a
Preliminary Plat with 45 townhome units as a Master Planned Development.

Title 15 Amendments (Public Hearing):
Planning Commission: This proposal updates Title 15 regarding the procedures and training for the Planning
Commission based on recently adopted state code.

Title 15 Amendments (Public Hearing):
Volleyball Training Facility: This proposal requests an amendment to the city's Municipal Code to allow indoor
volleyball facilities as a permitted use in the I-1 Light Industrial Zone.

These hearings will be held in the Council Chambers at 80 South Main Street, Second Floor, Spanish Fork. If
you have any questions or comments concerning these requests, please contact Kasey Woodard at
801.804.4580 or by email at kwoodard@spanishfork.gov. Written questions and comments will be forwarded to
the City Council.

We strive to make wise decisions to continue the fine traditions made by those who have gone before us.
These people built a solid foundation upon which our community stands - the foundation is based upon

7.2 Amendment No. 1 to the Vending Machines for Spanish Fork City FitCity Center Agreement: Addition of Location (Library)

7.3 Patey Aviation Consent to Lease Assignment
This agreement allows Patey Aviation Development, LLC, to obtain a loan secured by its Development Ground Lease. If the tenant defaults, the lender can take over or transfer the lease without breaching the Development Ground Lease agreement. The lender can fix issues to keep the lease active or create a new one if needed. Insurance and damages are used for repairs or to pay the loan, ensuring the lender is protected. Patey Aviation Consent to Lease Assignment.pdfPublic attachment

7.4 Airport Property Acquisition - 3226 N 1150 W Real Estate Purchase Contract & Promissory Note
Airport Property Acquisition - Taxiway Bravo

In order to construct the final leg of Taxiway Bravo at the Spanish Fork Municipal Airport, the City needs to acquire the property located at 3226 N. 1150 W. The property currently contains a veterinary clinic that is leased to an existing tenant.

Staff has negotiated a purchase price of $1,450,000. The purchase price will be paid in three interest-free installments: $500,000 at closing, $500,000 by July 1, 2027 or when the current tenant leaves (whichever occurs first), and $450,000 by January 15, 2028. Title to the property will transfer to the City at closing upon payment of the first $500,000. At closing, the City will also provide the seller with a promissory note for the remaining $950,000.

The seller has requested the ability to continue the existing lease with the veterinary clinic following closing. Under the proposed lease-back agreement, the City will lease the property back to the seller for $1.00, allowing the existing tenant to remain until the earlier of termination of the tenant's lease or December 31, 2027. During the lease-back period, the seller will remain responsible for utilities, property taxes, maintenance, and other applicable expenses.

6. CONSENT ITEMS

6.1 Draft Minutes of City Council for 08-04-2026
08 DRAFT City Council Minutes 08-04-2026 (4).pdf

6.2 Utah County Tourism Tax Advisory Board (TTAB) Grant Agreement
The Airport Manager applied for grant funding through the Utah County Tourism Tax Advisory Board (TTAB) to support the 2026 Wings & Wheels Airshow. Following a successful presentation to the TTAB, the Airport was awarded $25,000 to assist with eligible event expenses, including advertising, event management, and crowd control. Approval is requested to authorize the Mayor, City Recorder, and City Attorney to execute the grant agreement on behalf of Spanish Fork City.

487_2026_AGREEMENTS_6152026.pdfPublic attachment

6.3 FAA Federal Contract Tower Reimbursable Agreement
The FAA has presented Spanish Fork Airport with a Reimbursable Agreement to initiate the Federal Contract Tower Siting Study. While the study is fully reimbursable by the FAA, the Airport is required to advance the approximately $100,000 cost, with reimbursement occurring at a later date.

Execution of this agreement represents the official start of the Federal Contract Tower Program at Spanish Fork Airport and marks a significant milestone in the partnership between the Airport and the FAA. The siting study will identify the optimal location for the future control tower and is the first major step in the design and implementation process. Based on current FAA timelines, construction of the control tower is anticipated to begin within approximately five years of executing this agreement.

The Spanish Fork Airport Advisory Board unanimously recommended approval of the Reimbursable Agreement at its recent meeting. If approved by the City Council, the Airport Manager will be authorized to execute the agreement and return it to the FAA, allowing the siting study to commence.

Reimbursable Agreement AJW-FN-WSA-25-NM-007374 (Reimbursable Agreement).pdfPublic attachment

6.4 HOA West, LLC - Vista View - Fiber Service Agreement
This agreement gives Vista View residents a volume discounted price on SFCN internet.

This Bulk Service Agreement outlines an arrangement between HOA West, LLC and Spanish Fork Community Network (SFCN) to provide fiber internet services to the Vista View development. Key terms include:

-        Services: Fiber internet (up to 500 Mbps) for all units, effective September 1, 2026.

-        Responsibilities: Tenants are automatically enrolled without the option to opt-out. The Recipient is responsible for all wiring, maintenance, and testing, which must meet specific construction standards.

-        Billing: Services are billed at $30 per unit, per month, through the city's municipal utility billing system.

-        Contract Term: The agreement runs for an initial 48-month term, with automatic annual renewals thereafter.

-        Termination: After the first 24 months, the agreement can be terminated with 60 days' notice and payment of a fee equal to 75% of the remaining term costs

7. PUBLIC HEARING
 
7.1 Ordinance to amend Title 15 to modify the parking requirements for properties that have detached accessory dwelling units that are smaller than 650 square feet.
A change to Utah Code will take effect on October 1, 2026. Spanish Fork City is required to modify the zoning code to be consistent with the language in Utah Code that applies to properties with detached accessory dwelling units. This proposed Title 15 amendment would bring Spanish Fork City into conformity with State Law.

ordinance.title15detached.8-18-2026.pdfPublic attachment


7.2 Ordinance to amend the Zoning Map to change the zoning of a property from R-R and R-1-12 to C-2 located at approximately 400 North Spanish Fork Parkway.
This proposal involves changing the zoning of approximately 4.8 acres from R-R Rural Residential and R-1-12 Residential to C-2 General Commercial for property located on the southeast corner of 400 North and Spanish Fork Parkway. Approximately 75 feet of the currently zoned R-1-12 area is proposed to be included in the commercial request. The property is currently vacant and in agricultural production. 8.1Interlocal Cooperation Agreement for Building Inspection and Plan Review Services
At the request of Mapleton City, the Spanish Fork Building Inspection Division would like to enter into an interlocal agreement with Mapleton City for building inspection and plan review services. This interlocal agreement would provide building inspections and plan review services on an as-needed basis for both Mapleton and Spanish Fork. This interlocal agreement will fulfil the 2024 Senate Bill 185 requirement for us to provide three options for building inspections if the municipality cannot provide an inspector within three business days. Spanish Fork City doesn't anticipate using this service at the current time.
